system.description:
“Let my performance guide you.” You are a true battlefield conductor, creating a persistent aura of inspiring magic that makes your allies faster, stronger, and more resilient with every note.

LEVEL 3

Voice of the Muse.

You know Inspiration spells.

Inspiring Performance.

1 Action, Burst: 2. Spend a Songweaver's Inspiration. You can perform for 1 minute as if maintaining Concentration. Allies that start their turn in the area gain +2 speed until the end of their turn. While performing, you can spend 1 mana as an Action to give allies in the area KEY temp HP, 1 round.

LEVEL 7

Enchanting Performance.

While performing Inspiring Performance, you can spend 3 mana as an Action to force all enemies in the area to make a WIL save. On a fail, their speed is reduced to 0 as they dance on their next turn. On a save, they are Slowed, 1 turn.

LEVEL 11

Giddy Energy.

Allies that start their turn in the area of your performance begin to vibrate with energy, their next melee attack deals an additional 1d12 Force damage.

LEVEL 15

Grande Performance.

Inspiring Performance increases to Burst 4. Allies that start their turn in the area can move for free 1/turn. Temp HP gained by spending mana increases to 3xKEY.

Lyrical Weaponry

Never Gonna Give You Up! (1/encounter) 1 Action. Enemies that can hear you take LVL Psychic damage. Ignores armor. They must then make an INT save. On a fail, they are Dazed and knocked Prone, 1 turn. On a save, they are Slowed, 1 turn.

Never Gonna Let You Down! (1/encounter) 1 Action. Allies that can hear you gain 1d4 instances of advantage on their next activity. This advantage lasts until they succeed once.

A “People” Person

Alec Ristky, The Sentient Storybook. You summon a sentient storybook of endless curiosity and tomfoolery. The book will tell a special restorative tale for 10 minutes to those it deems good willed and kind. All who listen attentively for the duration gain the benefits of a Safe Rest and are somehow magically washed and cleaned. Once Alec Ristky tells you a tale, it won't do so again until you Safe Rest for at least 1 week.
